result.rationale: The diff computes `isTeamAdminOrOwner = (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be BOTH admin and owner, contradicting the variable name and the permission intent; a team admin who is not the owner (or per typical semantics, an owner who isn't an admin) fails the check and hits FORBIDDEN. The logical operator should almost certainly be `||`. This is a verifiable correctness defect introduced by the new addGuests.handler.ts in this diff.

judged_text: The authorization variable isTeamAdminOrOwner is computed with && (isTeamAdmin(user.id, teamId) && isTeamOwner(user.id, teamId)), so it is true only for owners, and team admins (role ADMIN, who satisfy isTeamAdmin but not isTeamOwner) are denied by the FORBIDDEN check at line 51. A team admin who is not the owner opens the Add Guests dialog on a team booking and always receives the 'you_do_not_have_permission' error, despite the variable name and feature intent saying admins are allowed; the requirement 'team admins can manage guests' is silently dropped.
